abort.already_configured: A hub with this name is already configured.

nodes.title: Select a discovered node
nodes.description: Search by name or NodeId. Save one node at a time; reopen these options to configure another.

node.title: Entity type
node.description: Node: {node}. Only compatible entity types are offered. Automatic keeps the existing mapping. Changing the domain creates a new entity; update automations and dashboards before removing the previous entity. Excluded nodes are not polled after reload.

number.title: Numeric limits
number.description: Node: {node}. Choose the editable range and control step. These are interface limits; they do not change the PLC configuration.

text.title: Text limits
text.description: Node: {node}. Set the maximum to the string capacity configured in the PLC (up to 255 characters for Home Assistant). Capacity is not discovered automatically. Spaces are preserved.

error.incompatible_platform: This entity type is incompatible with the node type or write permissions.
error.node_not_found: The node is no longer available. Reload the integration.
error.invalid_number_limits: Use finite numbers, minimum below maximum, and a positive step no greater than the range.
error.integer_limits_required: This node requires integer limits and step.
error.unsafe_integer_limits: Integer limits must be within ±9007199254740991 for exact representation in the interface.
error.limits_outside_type: The limits exceed the OPC UA data type range.
error.invalid_text_limits: Use integer lengths with 0 ≤ minimum ≤ maximum ≤ 255.

abort.integration_not_loaded: Load the integration before configuring its discovered nodes.
abort.no_nodes: No supported scalar nodes were discovered. Check the root NodeId and permissions, then reload.
